?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:180246
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Cancellation Application No. - 320 of 2022

Applicant :- Manju Yadav @ Rekha Yadav
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Mani Shanker Pandey

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Abhay Raj,Ray Sahab Yadav
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1. Heard Sri Mani Shanker Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant and Ray Sahab Yadav learned
counsel appearing on behalf of opposite party no.3 the accused and Sri Shatrughan Yadav learned
A.G.A. for the State.

2. The instant bail cancellation application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer
to cancel the bail of accused/opposite party no.2 namely Prabhat Kumar Yadav in Case Crime
No.826 of 2021, under Section 376 I.P.C., Police Station Naini, District Prayagraj/ Allahabad.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is informant of the case and he has filed the instant bail cancellation application on the ground that after released on bail opposite party no.2 i.e. accused of the case started pressuring the applicant to compromise the matter and in this regard applicant on 13.07.2022 also moved an application to the S.S.P. concerned.

He further submits that as after released on bail, opposite party no.2 misused the liberty of bail granted to him,
Manju Yadav @ Rekha Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65963963/
1 therefore, the bail granted to him be cancelled.
4.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Per contra learned A.G.A. as well as counsel appearing on behalf of the opposite party no.2 opposed the prayer for cancellation of bail and submit that on such vague and general ground bail granted to an accused should not be cancelled and if this Court cancel the bail granted to opposite party no.2 on such vague ground then this Court will open a pandora's box and therefore, instant bail cancellation is devoid of merit and is liable to be dismissed.
5.
I have heard both the parties and perused the record of the case.

6. The instant bail cancellation application has been moved by the applicant i.e. informant of the case on the ground that after released on bail opposite party no.2 pressurized him to compromise the matter and in this regard applicant also moved an application on 13.07.2022 to S.S.P., Prayagraj but I find force in the argument advanced by learned A.G.A. and learned counsel appearing on behalf of opposite party no.2 that on the basis of such general allegation bail granted to accused should not be cancelled.
7.

The law with regard to the cancellation of bail is settled that it is easy to reject the bail applicant but it is very difficult to cancel a bail already granted and for cancellation of bail very cogent and overwhelming reason are necessary which are missing in the present matter.
8. Therefore, from the discussion made above, in my opinion, the instant bail cancellation application is devoid on merit and is accordingly, dismissed.

Order Date :- 18.9.2023 Jitendra  Manju Yadav @ Rekha Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65963963/
